# telnyx_enterprise_reputation_numbers (Data Source)

Lists enterprise reputation numbers, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_enterprise_reputation_number`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enterprise_id` (String) The enterprise id.

### Optional

- `filter_ownership_status` (String) Result of ongoing ownership checks. `verified`: the number is with the carrier on record. `pending_confirmation`: the number's carrier changed, or a periodic ownership re-verification is due; confirm you still own it before `confirm_by`. `flagged`: a periodic re-verification went unanswered; the number stays monitored and is not removed, but confirm ownership (`POST .../ownership_confirm`) to return it to `verified`. `removed`: the number is no longer monitored; returned by `POST .../ownership_confirm` with `still_own: false`, and when listing numbers with `filter[ownership_status]=removed`. One of `flagged`, `pending_confirmation`, `removed`, `verified`.
- `filter_phone_number_contains` (String)
- `filter_phone_number_eq` (String)
- `filter_source` (String) Where the phone number is hosted. `telnyx`: in your Telnyx inventory. `external`: a number you own that is hosted with another provider. One of `external`, `telnyx`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `enterprise_reputation_numbers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enterprise_reputation_numbers))

<a id="nestedatt--enterprise_reputation_numbers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `enterprise_reputation_numbers`

Read-Only:

- `confirm_by` (String) Deadline to confirm you still own the number. Set only while `ownership_status` is `pending_confirmation`.
- `created_at` (String)
- `enterprise_id` (String)
- `flag_reason` (String) Why the number's ownership was flagged. `carrier_changed` when an ownership check found the number with a different carrier.
- `id` (String)
- `ownership_status` (String) Result of ongoing ownership checks. `verified`: the number is with the carrier on record. `pending_confirmation`: the number's carrier changed, or a periodic ownership re-verification is due; confirm you still own it before `confirm_by`. `flagged`: a periodic re-verification went unanswered; the number stays monitored and is not removed, but confirm ownership (`POST .../ownership_confirm`) to return it to `verified`. `removed`: the number is no longer monitored; returned by `POST .../ownership_confirm` with `still_own: false`, and when listing numbers with `filter[ownership_status]=removed`.
- `phone_number` (String) E.164 with leading `+`.
- `removal_reason` (String) Why the number was removed. Set only for removed numbers.
- `removed_at` (String) When the number was removed. Set only for removed numbers.
- `reputation_data` (Attributes) `null` until the first refresh has been collected for this number. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enterprise_reputation_numbers--reputation_data))
- `source` (String) Where the phone number is hosted. `telnyx`: in your Telnyx inventory. `external`: a number you own that is hosted with another provider.
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--enterprise_reputation_numbers--reputation_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `enterprise_reputation_numbers.reputation_data`

Read-Only:

- `connection_score` (Number)
- `engagement_score` (Number)
- `last_refreshed_at` (String)
- `maturity_score` (Number)
- `sentiment_score` (Number)
- `spam_category` (String) Category label from the reputation feed when the number is flagged.
- `spam_risk` (String) Overall spam-risk classification.
